name: Permissions changed on a privileged AD object
author: Sentra SOC
description: Windows 5136 nTSecurityDescriptor (new value) on AdminSDHolder, the domain root, the Domain Controllers OU, the Configuration / Schema roots or a built-in admin group / account (Domain / Enterprise / Schema Admins, Administrators, operators, krbtgt …). An ACE added here gives lasting control of the domain (AdminSDHolder is copied to every protected account every hour). AD Audit -> AD changes shows the ACEs added and removed. Needs 'Audit Directory Service Changes' on the DCs.

name: Group Policy linked, unlinked or enforced
author: Sentra SOC
description: Windows 5136 on gPLink / gPOptions of a domain, OU or site - a GPO was linked, unlinked, enforced or its link disabled, which changes which computers and users get its settings. Check it against an approved change.

name: Group Policy object created, changed or deleted
author: Sentra SOC
description: Windows 5136 (new value) / 5137 / 5141 on a groupPolicyContainer. Every edit of a GPO raises versionNumber, so one alert per GPO and editor per hour. The setting-level old / new comes from the GPO report snapshots (AD Audit -> Policy changes; needs ad_changes.gpo_server).

name: Active Directory schema changed
author: Sentra SOC
description: An attributeSchema / classSchema object under CN=Schema was created, changed, moved or deleted (5136-5141). Schema changes are forest-wide and cannot be undone; they normally come only with a product install (Exchange, LAPS …) under an approved change.

name: DNS record of a host changed or removed by someone else
author: Sentra SOC
description: An existing AD-integrated DNS record lost its value (5136 dnsRecord 'Value Deleted') or was deleted (5141 dnsNode), and the change was not the host updating its own record. Repointing a server's name (A / CNAME) redirects its users (credential capture, man-in-the-middle). Narrow it to your server names with an override (fields.dns_record startswith srv / dc …). Needs auditing (SACL) on the DomainDnsZones / ForestDnsZones partitions.

name: Audit policy weakened (auditing removed)
author: Sentra SOC
description: Windows 4719 where success or failure auditing was removed from a subcategory - what the server records from now on was reduced. Applied by Group Policy shows the computer account as the actor: then find the GPO change (SENTRA-ADC-003).

name: Domain password or lockout policy changed
author: Sentra SOC
description: Windows 4739 - the domain password, lockout or logoff policy changed (minimum length, history, lockout threshold …). AD Audit -> Policy changes lists the settings with their new and previous values.

name: Directory replication rights used by an account that is not a DC (DCSync)
author: Sentra SOC
description: Windows 4662 with the Replicating Directory Changes (All / In Filtered Set) extended rights by an account that is not a computer account - the DCSync technique that reads every password hash. 4662 is not in the default WEF subscriptions: add it to the sentra-dc subscription (Audit Directory Service Access) for this rule to see anything. Exclude Azure AD Connect's sync account with an override.
